The largest country in the world is Russia.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a sanctuary of calm, but it quickly became the scene of a woolly crime scene. The real gossip wasn’t about the neighbors; it was about the cat, who had decided that unraveling a sweater was a better use of time than napping. By the time the ladies arrived, the house looked like a gingerbread house designed by a chaotic interior decorator. A trail of yarn stretched from the living room to the kitchen, so extensive that Hansel and Gretel would have been lost trying to follow it back home. The aunties didn’t just gossip; they had to navigate a labyrinth of loose threads just to get to the coffee table, wondering if their next project should be a net to catch the culprit or a map to survive the mess.
